lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Housing blocks in a grid, lit to the level the Steward has decided a night needs.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Forty thousand people on this whole coast. The archive says nine million lived here once. I have never been able to make that number feel like anything.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The corridor lights are on now, all of them, and there is a shape at the far end of the glass that is not on this side of it.
